inputs.name: LoginChallengeService.constructor.options
inputs.description: Options required to construct the service: a one-time challenge store, an AuthSecrets implementation for hashing, and a clock returning epoch milliseconds. The clock sets challenge expiry and supplies claim time.

inputs.name: LoginChallengeService.consume.cookie
inputs.description: The raw challenge cookie returned by issue, or null when it is absent; the service hashes a present value to claim its one-time record. A missing, expired, already claimed, or otherwise unclaimable cookie fails with AuthFailure code challenge-invalid.

inputs.name: LoginChallengeService.consume.csrf
inputs.description: The raw CSRF value returned in issue's challenge; consume hashes it and compares that hash with the claimed record's csrfHash. A mismatch fails with AuthFailure code challenge-invalid.

outputs.name: CHALLENGE_TTL
outputs.description: Challenge lifetime in milliseconds; fixed at five minutes (5 * 60 * 1000). issue adds this duration to now() for the stored record's expiresAt.

outputs.name: LoginChallengeService.issue
outputs.description: Resolves to the generated cookie token and an AuthChallenge with nonce and csrf values after saving the hashed cookie and CSRF values with a five-minute expiry. The cookie is intended for an HttpOnly cookie, while the nonce is passed to Google Identity Services.

outputs.name: LoginChallengeService.consume
outputs.description: Resolves to the claimed record's nonce when the cookie and CSRF value match. The claim is single-use, and a missing cookie, unavailable record, or CSRF mismatch throws AuthFailure with code challenge-invalid.

errors.name: AuthFailure
errors.description: Thrown by consume with code challenge-invalid and HTTP status 401 when the cookie is absent, the one-time record cannot be claimed, or the CSRF hash does not match.
